amendments.effect: Smoke finding: commandcode/stealth/glyph-cluster:free answered 429 "You have used all 1000 free Glyph Cluster requests for today"; the allowance is shared with other work on the account and the campaign needs about 6,300-10,000 judge calls. The panel becomes opencode-go/iceman-contributor-free + kilo/dots-studio/dots-3-note-preview:free (neither answers). The small answer model becomes kilo/nvidia/nemotron-3-nano-omni-30b-a3b-reasoning:free (3B active); the large model, routes, arms, caps and billing are unchanged. Work-outcome simulators: large jobs simulate with the Nemotron nano, small jobs with crouton-alpha-free (never a job's own answer model). Manifest hash re-bound.

amendments.text: "You can use paid models for these. From ollama cloud, you can use beam, gpt-oss 20b and 120b, nemotron-3-nano, gemma4:31b, and lastly clef as the decision model. go ahead and finish the rest of the tasks. These are paid model so you do not need to throttle as hard. But there is a 5 hour rate limit which needs to be considered" (owner, 2026-11-08).
amendments.effect: Every route moves to Ollama Cloud (Pro: $60 included a month, 3 concurrent requests; prices from ollama.com/pricing, 2026-11-08, in rates.json). Roles (assistant's mapping): beam answers large, nemotron-3-nano:30b answers small, gpt-oss:120b + gemma4:31b judge (neither answers), gpt-oss:20b simulates the work-outcome user, clef:27b is the P3-P5 decider (phase B). Models with named thinking levels run at medium effort for every arm (beam defaults to max, which would spend the output bound). Billing becomes paid-allowance: before each job the campaign reads /api/balance; a closed session or weekly window (the owner's 5-hour window) is waited out until resets_at, and an allowance under the $1.50 reserve halts the campaign, resumable next period. OM jobs (about 5.7M input tokens a BEAM-1M question in the smoke) are capped at 30M input tokens each and run last, so the allowance reaches every other arm first. Free-route pacing is off (the jobs are no longer free-only). Arms, suites, partition, criteria and pairing are unchanged. Manifest hash re-bound. Bounded-wire accounting (a whole context window charged per request, for free routes that omit usage) is off: Ollama Cloud reports usage on every reply (native prompt_eval_count / eval_count, read by the wire proxy), and a 1M-window charge would end a beam job after about 23 requests (smoke 2026-11-08).
